title: Equitable Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Equitable Holdings filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026, disclosing it's exploring share repurchases of its common stock prior to closing its pending merger with Corebridge Financial (announced March 26, 2026). The company would need a waiver from Corebridge to proceed with repurchases during the pendency of the merger. No determination has been made whether repurchases will occur.

why_it_matters: Routine corporate SEC filing regarding potential share repurchases during pending merger. Limited market-significant information disclosed; the filing explicitly states 'There can be no assurance that the Company will determine to make such share repurchases.'
